name: Claude Monet
findings: Within his own canvases, malachite green turns up as a small accent in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 4.1x the archive's rate (from 1100 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, light cadmium turns up as the lightest note in 80% of the paintings that hold it, 2.4x the archive's rate (from 1100 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, cocoa turns up as the shadow in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 2.9x the archive's rate (from 1100 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 1100 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark walnut, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 1100 paintings here).
Pairs dark peacock with teal blue more than chance would predict (3 of 1100 paintings here).
Pairs cinnamon with mikado brown more than chance would predict (3 of 1100 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (french grey, light mouse grey, cement) covers 66% of his paintings here.
